prompt: Checkov reports many failed checks in this Terraform repository. Fix every failed check on the database resources, that is every RDS instance, DynamoDB table and ElastiCache replication group wherever it is declared, and only those: the checks of every other resource must keep their current result. Fix them by changing arguments of those resources; use the customer managed KMS key and the RDS monitoring role the configuration already defines. Keep every resource and every .tf file, do not add or remove resources, do not add checkov:skip comments or a Checkov config file, and do not run terraform. Finish when Checkov reports no failed check on those resources.
verify:
checkov -d . --framework terraform --skip-download -o json 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/python3 -I -c 'import hashlib, json, sys
r = json.load(sys.stdin)
s = r["summary"]
scope = ("aws_db_instance", "aws_dynamodb_table", "aws_elasticache_replication_group")
kind = lambda a: a.split(".")[-2]
res = r["results"]
bad = [c for c in res["failed_checks"] if kind(c["resource"]) in scope]
seen = {c["resource"] for c in res["passed_checks"] if kind(c["resource"]) in scope}
out = sorted("%s %s %s" % (k, c["resource"], c["check_id"]) for k in ("failed", "passed") for c in res[k + "_checks"] if kind(c["resource"]) not in scope)
ok = not bad and len(seen) == 4 and s["skipped"] == 0 and s["parsing_errors"] == 0 and hashlib.sha256("\n".join(out).encode()).hexdigest() == "a40d6eaab9a3ef98e387a8ed8c34ceea513d32fd9ecf7ecc9cfcdbf504d5a761"
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)' && ! grep -rqi 'checkov:skip' . && [ -z "$(find . -name '.checkov*' | head -1)" ] && [ "$(find . -name '*.tf' | sort | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-64)" = 7454a22023b6d5da366eb68af6370e07406020589113ea38c268f253e2176c9d ] && [ "$(find . -name '*.tf' | sort | xargs grep -h '^resource "' | sort | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-64)" = 615611921641e01ebc876ba5a5787c13026c1788a7aec1444992806a2850c3c1 ]
